candidates.original_assertion_paraphrase: v1 reports the 2009–2011 CNGS analysis arrival-time difference as 60.7 ±6.9 statistical ±7.4 systematic ns.
candidates.replacement_assertion_paraphrase: v4 reports 6.5 ±7.4 statistical, +8.3/−8.0 systematic ns after corrections for instrumental effects; the collaboration identifies the prior anomaly's instrumental sources.
candidates.downstream_assertion_paraphrase: v1 reports (v−c)/c=(2.48 ±0.28 statistical ±0.30 systematic)×10^-5 and 6.0σ significance. v4 instead reports (2.7 ±3.1 statistical +3.4/−3.3 systematic)×10^-6 and describes arrival as compatible with light speed within errors.
candidates.essential_dependency: Both versions explicitly give (v−c)/c=δt/(TOF′c−δt), using an effective 730.085 km neutrino baseline. This is source-specified computation, not an invented threshold or topical link.
candidates.retention_control: Both versions retain the independently geodetically measured BCT-to-OPERA baseline 731278.0 ±0.2 m. The source explains GPS benchmarks and terrestrial traverse; this measurement does not derive from corrected timing δt.
candidates.alternative_support: v4 also reports a different likelihood construction and the late-2011 short-bunch test. Those corroborate the corrected conclusion but do not independently support the earlier 6σ velocity assertion. Do not withdraw all OPERA claims.
representation_limits: Replacement can target the whole reported δt estimate with uncertainties, rather than edit an isolated numeric field.
Both analyses use 2009–2011 data, but selected samples differ: v1 has16111 events; v4 has15223, discarding roughly5% with isolated early hits. Thus not literally identical selected observations.
The new 2012 dedicated-beam experiment was not inspected or substituted for a correction.
Generic numerical claims do not themselves supply a temporal-QA task; no dates/intervals/questions were invented.

The final source directly corrects both the measured delta and the downstream velocity/conclusion. Their formula establishes dependency, but does not by itself establish added propagation value beyond reading the explicit correction; any later demonstration must distinguish these.
